selection_method: Stage 5 quantitative brand profiling and multi-criteria scoring
reason: Brand 'AmazonHelp' achieved the highest composite score (0.8043) across all 108 evaluated brands. It provides the largest conversation volume (82,467 conversations, 373,057 tweets), outstanding conversational depth (62.1% multi-turn), highest domain & intent diversity proxy (0.8549), substantial resolution corpus (26,222 substantive resolutions), and balanced escalation behavior (37.6%).
